title.zh-CN: 持续胸痛伴大汗 · 80岁女性
title.en: Persistent chest pain and sweating · 80-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 急性胸痛的机制需要结合冠脉、心内结构和长期用药判断。
summary.en: The mechanism of acute chest pain requires coronary, intracardiac and medication evidence.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合房颤、IVUS 与超声判断栓塞机制。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate AF, IVUS and echo to assess embolic mechanism.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别右室缺血合并低血压的高风险状态。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the high-risk combination of RV ischaemia and hypotension.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出抗凝与出血风险的个体化评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Propose individualised anticoagulation and bleeding-risk assessment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分个案操作与通用建议。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a case-specific procedure from a general recommendation.

zh-CN: 调阅心电图与入院观测

text.zh-CN: 血压 88/62 mmHg、心率 62 次/分；Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF ST 抬高 0.15–0.2 mV，V3R–V5R 抬高 0.1 mV。
text.en: BP 88/62 mmHg, heart rate 62/min; ST elevation 0.15–0.2 mV in II, III, aVF and 0.1 mV in V3R–V5R.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 右冠远段大量血栓、TIMI 1；抽吸后管壁光滑无明显狭窄。IVUS 示内膜完整、无斑块破裂，未放支架。
text.en: Heavy distal RCA thrombus with TIMI 1 flow; after aspiration the vessel was smooth without significant stenosis. IVUS showed an intact intima without plaque rupture and no stent was placed.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

zh-CN: 调阅术后第 3 天超声

text.zh-CN: 左房增大，左房游离壁回声考虑血栓；下壁、后壁运动减弱，LVEF 55%。
text.en: Enlarged left atrium with a free-wall echo considered thrombus; reduced inferior/posterior wall motion and LVEF 55%.

text.zh-CN: 肌钙蛋白 I 94.12 μg/L（参考 0–0.04），BNP 3981.2 ng/L；入院 INR 1.1，肌酐 57.3 μmol/L。
text.en: Troponin I 94.12 μg/L (reference 0–0.04), BNP 3981.2 ng/L; admission INR 1.1 and creatinine 57.3 μmol/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告使用华法林及过渡期肝素、阿司匹林；第 6 天 INR 2.3 后停肝素。前 10 天有心衰症状，随后改善并加用相应药物。长期栓塞和出血结局未载。
text.en: The source used warfarin with bridging heparin and aspirin; heparin stopped when INR reached 2.3 on day 6. Heart-failure symptoms persisted for about ten days then improved. Long-term embolic and bleeding outcomes are absent.

prompt.en: Which mechanism best fits the evidence?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 房颤相关冠脉栓塞高度可能
text.en: AF-related coronary embolism is highly likely

feedback.zh-CN: 未抗栓房颤、房内血栓及缺乏破裂斑块相互支持。
feedback.en: Untreated AF, atrial thrombus and absent rupture evidence are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 已经证明典型斑块破裂
text.en: Typical plaque rupture is proven

feedback.zh-CN: IVUS 和抽吸后血管形态不支持该说法。
feedback.en: IVUS and the post-aspiration appearance do not support that assertion.

text.zh-CN: 肌钙蛋白升高仅为肾功能异常
text.en: Troponin elevation is solely from renal dysfunction

feedback.zh-CN: 冠脉与心电图已有急性缺血证据。
feedback.en: Coronary and ECG evidence establishes an acute ischaemic process.

prompt.en: How should long-term antithrombotic care be planned?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 围绕房颤栓塞风险及出血风险个体化抗凝，重新核对合并抗血小板的必要性
text.en: Individualise anticoagulation for AF embolic and bleeding risks and review the need for added antiplatelets

feedback.zh-CN: 应处理栓子来源，旧方案不能替代现行风险评估。
feedback.en: The embolic source needs treatment; historical regimens do not replace current risk assessment.

text.zh-CN: 只用双联抗血小板即可替代房颤抗凝
text.en: Dual antiplatelets alone replace anticoagulation for AF

feedback.zh-CN: 两者作用与适应证不同。
feedback.en: They address different mechanisms and indications.

text.zh-CN: 所有高龄患者自动放弃抗凝
text.en: Avoid anticoagulation in every elderly patient

feedback.zh-CN: 年龄需纳入风险权衡，不能单独排除。
feedback.en: Age informs risk assessment but does not automatically exclude treatment.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何评价抽吸及机制证据？
prompt.en: How should aspiration and mechanism evidence be judged?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 本例抽吸及 IVUS 有帮助，但不能推广常规抽吸，也未直接拍到栓子迁移
text.en: Aspiration/IVUS helped here, but do not justify routine aspiration or prove filmed embolus migration

feedback.zh-CN: 来源是综合推断而非直接观察；历史操作不是通用规则。
feedback.en: The source is inferred rather than directly observed; the procedure is not a universal rule.

text.zh-CN: 所有心梗都应常规血栓抽吸
text.en: All infarctions require routine aspiration

feedback.zh-CN: 单例不能支持普遍操作。
feedback.en: One case cannot support routine use.

text.zh-CN: 未放支架说明没有心肌梗死
text.en: No stent means no myocardial infarction

feedback.zh-CN: 恢复血流后无固定狭窄不否定已有心肌损伤。
feedback.en: Absence of residual stenosis does not negate myocardial injury.

text.en: Avoid generalising case-specific aspiration or historical antithrombotic targets

text.en: Choose an evidence-consistent plan on the first attempt

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 资料支持房颤相关冠脉栓塞导致下壁及右室心肌梗死；需要机制导向的长期风险评估。
conclusion.en: The evidence supports AF-related coronary embolism causing inferior/RV infarction, requiring mechanism-based long-term risk assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 无斑块破裂与房内血栓使栓塞机制更可信。
keyReasoning.en: Absent plaque rupture and atrial thrombus favour embolism.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗凝与抗血小板并非互相替代。
keyReasoning.en: Anticoagulation and antiplatelet therapy are not interchangeable.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 源头机制仍是综合推断。
keyReasoning.en: The source mechanism remains an integrated inference.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 未直接记录栓子迁移，长期随访及完整抗栓禁忌证评估未载。
unknowns.en: Embolus migration was not directly observed; long-term follow-up and complete antithrombotic contraindication assessment are absent.
